description: Score-honest selector over the measured non-external winners: article geometry v6 for large sorted typed-channel LZMA, article receipt family tree for small custom graph/receipt prefixes, and schema-title-streams LZMA2 for full-corpus scale. The selected archive is tagged and all embedded engines are counted in this directory.
codec: complete-archive selector: receipt graph, article geometry LZMA, schema/title stream LZMA2
notes: This is a measured-union baseline, not a claim of S<=100M. It prevents weaker experimental transforms from replacing stronger existing engines.
